title: Lior and the Will
author: C. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Lena Thackeray, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
